baslik: Campus Facilities, Extracurricular Clubs & Academic Collocations
paragraflar: Campus Facilities & Clubs: Library, science lab, IT room, gymnasium, conference hall ve canteen başlıca kampüs birimleridir; öğrenciler Robotics, Debate, Drama gibi kulüplere (extracurricular clubs) katılır.
Academic Collocations: Attend classes, take notes, do an experiment, hand in/submit an assignment, revise for exams ve give a presentation temel akademik kalıplardır.
